verdict.rationale: Titan is a physical FIDO/U2F hardware authenticator that proves a person holds the key at sign-in. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a service or identity-platform capability, so this story is a category error for this product. The probe confirms Titan has no vendor API, CLI, or SDK surface, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
